description: Create an alert rule. mode "instant" sends each matching mention as it happens; "hourly" sends one digest every UTC hour (five minutes past) for the previous hour, nothing when it had no mention over the floor, takes no schedule and no email channel (Slack, Telegram, webhook); "daily" sends one digest at schedule.hour in schedule.timezone; "weekly" sends one a week on schedule.weekday (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday). filter narrows by keywordIds, platforms, minRelevance (the relevance floor: absent sends relevant mentions only, 40 and up; 0 sends every scored match, noise included), minConfidence, sentiments, intents, excludeAuthors, minFollowers, tags, linkHosts (the hosts a post links to, a host or any subdomain of it). channelIds come from list_channels.

event.description: Custom event name for webhook payloads; null for the mode default.

anyOf.description: OR across groups: a mention passes when it meets every condition of at least one group (1 to 10 groups). The other conditions still apply to every mention: the whole filter is (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). A group takes the conditions of a view filter (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists ...), with no anyOf of its own.

items.description: A group of conditions, all of which must hold: the vocabulary of a view filter, without anyOf.

automated.description: true: only posts that read as machine-made; false: only the rest.

excludeAuthors.description: Never these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs.

groupIds.description: Only matches of keywords in any of these groups (grp_...).

intents.description: Only mentions carrying any of these intent or topic tags.

isReply.description: true: only replies and comments; false: only top-level posts.

keywordIds.description: Only matches of any of these keywords.

keywordKinds.description: Only matches of keywords of any of these kinds: brand, competitor, topic.

languages.description: Only posts in any of these languages (ISO 639-1).

linkHosts.description: Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it.

maxFollowers.description: Only authors with at most this many followers; unknown reach never passes.

minBookmarks.description: Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minConfidence.description: Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this.

minFollowers.description: Only authors with at least this many followers; unknown reach never passes.

minLikes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minQuotes.description: Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minRelevance.description: Only mentions scored at least this.

minReplies.description: Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minReposts.description: Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minViews.description: Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

notGroupIds.description: Never matches of keywords in these groups.

notLanguages.description: Never posts in these languages; an unknown language still passes.

notLinkHosts.description: Never posts linking to these hosts.

notRatings.description: Never reviews with these star ratings; posts that are not reviews still pass.

notSentiments.description: Never these sentiments; an unscored mention still passes.

notTags.description: Never authors tagged with any of these.

platforms.description: Only posts from any of these platforms.

q.description: Substring in the post text or the author's name.

ratings.description: Only app store reviews with any of these star ratings; every other post fails it.

relevant.description: true: only mentions the classifier scored relevant; false: only the rest.

status.description: Only mentions in this status: open, ignored, done.

tags.description: Only authors your workspace tagged with any of these.

automated.description: true: only posts that read as machine-made (bots, templated posts); false: only the rest. Omit for both.

excludeAuthors.description: Never these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs.

groupIds.description: Only keywords in these groups (grp_...): one rule per customer, say.

intents.description: At least one of these intent or topic tags.

languages.description: Only posts in any of these languages (ISO 639-1: en, es, de). A post whose language is unknown never passes.

linkHosts.description: Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it (octolens.com also matches blog.octolens.com). A post with no links never passes.

minBookmarks.description: Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minConfidence.description: Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this, 0 to 1. A mention without a confidence never passes.

minFollowers.description: Only authors with at least this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.

minLikes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minQuotes.description: Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minRelevance.description: The rule's relevance floor. Absent, it sends relevant mentions only (scored 40 and up, the classifier's line); lower, down to 0, it also receives the matches the classifier scored as noise; higher, it hears less. Email channels keep the 40 line whatever the rule says. Unclassified mentions never pass.

minReplies.description: Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minReposts.description: Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minViews.description: Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

notRatings.description: Never reviews with these star ratings (1 to 5): [5] keeps the five star reviews out. Posts that are not reviews still pass.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place), rss (RSS and Atom feeds a keyword reads).

ratings.description: Only app store reviews with any of these star ratings (1 to 5): [1, 2] sends the unhappy ones. Every other post fails it.

tags.description: Only authors your workspace tagged with any of these.

schedule.description: Required for daily and weekly alerts (weekly ones also need schedule.weekday). Hourly alerts take none: they send every UTC hour, so a time of day and a zone are ignored and a weekday is refused.

weekday.description: Weekly rules: the day it sends, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday. Required for mode weekly; ignored on daily rules.
